استقربا (form X)

# اُسْتُقْرِبَا (ustuqribā) /us.tuq.ri.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# اِسْتَقْرِبَا (istaqribā) /is.taq.ri.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
